design: Attempts are NEW_NOISE (fresh initial latent, anchor action, from step 0) or ACTION_VARIANT (branch the best noise at step 12 with a different wording/CFG). Decision B picks the kind every expand_every finished attempts; decision A can abort an attempt at steps 12/16/20, refunding the unspent steps. Hard NFE cap, exact at 2 NFE/step. Selection on HPSv3.
